summary: The prepared base already contains the open upstream candidate fixes: exact-SM120 QSA decode routes to FlashInfer TRT-LLM instead of the uniform-dtype FA4 fallback, and cached chunk-prefill casts FP8 K/V loads to the BF16 query dtype. No additional runtime correction was justified. Focused routing regressions pass, and the architecture-independent FP8 chunk-prefill computation matches an independent PyTorch reference on gfx950.

tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, QSA chunk-prefill output for BF16 queries with FP8 e4m3 K/V matched an independent float32 PyTorch softmax/einsum reference at top-k 1, 16, and 17; maximum absolute error was 0.00390625. BF16-cache boundary controls also passed, with maximum absolute error 0.0078125.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-df0c0a48c07f/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/kernel/qsa/test_qsa.py -k 'qsa_trtllm_sparse_decode_arch_gate or qsa_sm121_resolves_kda_varlen_kernel or qsa_chunk_prefill_accepts_fp8_cached_prefix'
tests.what_was_measured: Five focused regressions passed: the FP8 cached-prefix numerical regression, three SM100/SM120/other-SM12x TRT-LLM resolver boundaries, and the SM121 fallback resolver boundary.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-df0c0a48c07f/gpu_qsa_fp8_check.log records six numerical cases executed on AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-.

remaining_limitations: The assigned gfx950 GPU cannot execute or qualify the original NVIDIA SM120 FA4/FlashInfer TRT-LLM path.
The reported RadixArk/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 weights were unavailable, so no full server warmup or model-level reproduction was performed.

The existing candidate fixes remain open upstream as sgl-project/sglang PRs 36556 and 36644 at investigation time; upstream issue comments describing SM120 model runs are retained only as external evidence.
